tags.db.query.text:
select "table_meta"."id", "table_meta"."name", "table_meta"."description", "table_meta"."icon", "table_meta"."base_id", "table_meta"."db_table_name", "table_meta"."search_index", "fields"."fields", "views"."views", exists (
  select 1
  from reference r
  inner join field f_from on f_from.id = r.from_field_id
  inner join field f_to on f_to.id = r.to_field_id
  where f_from.table_id = table_meta.id
    and f_from.deleted_time is null
    and f_to.deleted_time is null
) as "has_outbound_reference" from "table_meta" left join lateral (select (select coalesce(json_agg(agg), '[]') from (select "id", "name", "description", "type", "options", "meta", "ai_config", "cell_value_type", "is_multiple_cell_value", "not_null", "unique", "is_primary", "is_computed", "is_lookup", "is_conditional_lookup", "has_error", "lookup_linked_field_id", "lookup_options", "db_field_name", "db_field_type", "version", "is_pending" from "field" where "field"."table_id" = "table_meta"."id" and "deleted_time" is null and ("is_pending" is null or "is_pending" = $1) order by "is_primary" is null asc, "is_primary", "order", "created_time") as agg) as "fields") as "fields" on true left join lateral (select (select coalesce(json_agg(agg), '[]') from (select "id", "name", "description", "type", "options", "order", "version", "column_meta", "sort", "filter", "group", "is_locked", "enable_share", "share_id", "share_meta", "created_time", "last_modified_time", "created_by", "last_modified_by" from "view" where "view"."table_id" = "table_meta"."id" and "deleted_time" is null order by "order") as agg) as "views") as "views" on true where ((("deleted_time" is null and "table_meta"."provision_state" = 'ready') and "base_id" = $2) and "id" = $3)
